notes: Ability definitions and species ability slots were extracted directly from the supplied ROM.
Ability ID 0 is the engine's NONE ability and is represented as null in species slots.
Each species/form has two normal ability slots and one hidden-ability slot.
Duplicate ability IDs across slots are preserved; battle-only forms such as Mega Pokémon can intentionally use the same ability in all slots.
aiRating and ability flags are engine metadata used by the ROM's battle/ability logic.
